data.headline: Six Asbury Park agenda items mention Block 3801 entitlement activity

claims.text: The agenda records six items mentioning the Asbury Park Waterfront Redevelopment Area, including Block 3801 and 320 Asbury Avenue.

citation.quote: Concerning Property Located At Block 3801, Lot 1.021 (F/K/A Block 3801, a Portion Of Lot 1.02) 320 Asbury Avenue On The City Tax Map within the Asbury Park Waterfront Redevelopment Area

claims.text: It also lists a special assessment covering wastewater, stormwater, roadway, streetscape, utility and other infrastructure improvements constructed on or benefiting that property.

citation.quote: Providing For The Special Assessment Of The Cost Of Certain Wastewater, Stormwater, Roadway, Streetscape, Utility And Other Infrastructure Improvements Constructed On Or Benefiting 3801, Lot 1.021 (F/K/A Block 3801, A Portion Of Lot 1.02) 320 Asbury Avenue

claims.text: The company says its strategy is to monetize remaining development sites and operating assets through sales to third-party developers and operators.

citation.quote: Our current strategy for the Asbury Park Waterfront investment is to actively asset manage our operating assets, and strategically monetize the remaining development sites and our operating assets through sales to third party developers and operators

claims.text: The company is the managing member of the joint venture owning the Asbury Park Waterfront investment, which had an aggregate carrying value of approximately $120.9 million as of June 30, 2026.

citation.quote: We are the managing member in Asbury Partners, LLC, which is the joint venture that owns the Asbury Park Waterfront investment. The aggregate carrying value of the Asbury Park Waterfront investment was approximately $120.9 million as of June 30, 2026.
